answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The umber is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the zephyr. What survives to the oasis is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
